scope: Reviewed instruction omissions and acceptance details, not an exhaustive copy of every reward predicate. Empty entries mean no supplement was recorded for that reviewed task. Static geometry is in the native environment frame; object axes are native asset axes.

build_tower: The required tower has two support pairs and two boards, followed by two specific top pieces; an arbitrary stable tower does not satisfy the evaluator. Source labels identify the required parts: block0 is the lower board, block7 the upper board; block1/block5 form one interchangeable support group and block2/block6 the other.

Place one support from each group below block0, and the remaining pair above block0 and below block7. Center block7 over the support region of block0 (4.3 cm radius). Place block3 above block7 and block4 above block3, each within the lower part's 2.3 cm support region.

All parts must have local +Z upright within 5 degrees, except block4, whose local +Y must point up. The local X axes of block3 and block7, and of block4 and block3, must be parallel or antiparallel within 20 degrees.
